items.why: Oil prices hit a 5-month high ahead of the flash October inflation data, making energy the standout tape item Friday.
Volatility jumped over 4% as the tech selloff deepened and hedge fund returns worsened through the week.
No single headline; moving with the broader tape as tech steadies to end the week.
Meta slumped after earnings, dragging the Nasdaq down 694 points on the session.

market_note: Late Friday tape: Dow futures down about 1.2%, S&P futures down 0.5%, Nasdaq futures near flat as tech steadies.
summary: Stocks closed out a rocky week lower, with oil's run to a 5-month high and Meta's post-earnings slump leading the moves while the VIX jumped above 19.
